description: Sally vLEI audit reporting agent: unknown credentials, exceptions, escrows, and webhook pipeline. Source: /metrics on each Sally instance.

panels.title: Unknown-schema credentials
panels.description: Stored credentials whose schema is not QVI, LE, OOR, or OOR Auth.

panels.title: Undetermined status
panels.description: Credentials with status unknown-registry or no-tel-events: Sally cannot say whether they are issued or revoked.

panels.title: TEL-only credentials
panels.description: TEL events with no ACDC, typically a revocation sent here for a credential presented to another instance.

panels.title: Missing chain edges
panels.description: Credentials whose qvi, le, or auth edge points at a credential this instance does not hold.

panels.title: Exceptions, last 1h
panels.description: All sally_exceptions_total kinds combined. See the Exceptions row for the breakdown.

panels.title: Webhook drops, last 24h
panels.description: Events removed from the pipeline because the webhook never returned 2xx within the escrow timeout.

panels.title: Credentials by type
panels.description: type=unknown is a schema Sally does not recognise.

panels.title: Credentials by status
panels.description: Anything other than issued or revoked needs a look.

panels.title: Exceptions by kind over the selected range
panels.description: Each bar is one kind label of sally_exceptions_total, summed over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Exception rate, all kinds
panels.description: Counters reset on restart; increase() tolerates that.

panels.title: Exception kinds, current totals since process start
panels.description: Raw counter values. Compare with Process uptime below to interpret.

panels.title: ACDC escrows
panels.description: Credentials parked by keripy because something they depend on has not arrived.

panels.title: TEL escrows
panels.description: TEL events parked by keripy. The red series is the subset of out-of-order events whose credential this instance does not hold.

panels.title: Webhook pipeline depth
panels.description: iss/rev: awaiting verification. recv/revk: awaiting webhook. ack: delivered, awaiting cleanup.

panels.title: Process uptime
panels.description: A low value after an unexpected drop in counters means Sally restarted.

panels.title: Snapshot walk duration
panels.description: Time the per-credential classification takes. It runs on Sally's main thread at most once every 30s.

title: Sally
